name: Seated Dip (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Grip the handles and press down until your arms are straight.
Keep the elbows tracking back, not flaring.
Return slowly. The machine path makes this an accessible triceps builder.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: Seated Dip (Machine) is a beginner pushing exercise for the triceps, performed with a machine. Pressing strength keeps daily pushing tasks — and your shoulders — working well for decades.
